> 二十七章 有喜（第1页）
“看看我们今天吃些什么？”蓝烨磊掀开盖子。
四碟小菜和一碗粥，分别是清炒虾仁，麻婆豆腐，素炒卷心菜和清蒸鲈鱼，还有一碗瘦肉粥，都是沈沛珊最爱吃的。
“相公，是你吩咐厨房做的吗？”沈沛珊惊喜的问道。拿起筷子，她开心的吃着。
“傻瓜，寺庙里是不准吃晕的你忘记了吗？”蓝烨磊笑着说道：“是我刚刚骑马从城里买来的。”
沈沛珊停下手中的筷子，看着蓝烨磊，感动的说：“相公，你清早起来，就出去为我买吃的回来？”
“是啊！最近看你都不怎么爱吃东西，就想买些你爱吃的。”搂着沈沛珊纤细的腰肢，蓝烨磊说：“你看你，又瘦了，不吃东西怎么行呢？快吃吧，再不吃就凉透了。”
沈沛珊转身搂住蓝烨磊，把头贴在他的胸膛前，听着他平稳的心跳，“相公待我真好！”
“傻瓜，我不待你好，待谁好呢？”拿起筷子塞在沈沛珊的手中，“快些吃吧！再不吃，就真的凉了。”
沈沛珊夹起一个虾仁，放在蓝烨磊的嘴里说：“那我们一起吃。”
蓝烨磊甜蜜的嚼着虾仁，似乎比山珍海味还要好吃，脸上始终挂着一丝微笑。
大概是菜对胃口，沈沛珊吃的很多，很饱。刚刚放下碗筷，一股反胃的感觉涌上喉咙，快速的跑到门外，沈沛珊扶着院子里的大树一阵狂呕，刚刚吃下的饭菜全部敬给了土地爷。
蓝烨磊吓的脸色都青了，急急的问：“珊儿，你怎么了？是不是这饭菜做的不干净？怎么呕的这么厉害？”
似乎把胃都翻了底朝天，沈沛珊才停止呕吐。看着蓝烨磊急得如热锅上的蚂蚁，她扑哧一声笑了出来。
“傻瓜，”她娇羞的扑倒他的怀里，轻声的说道：“不是饭菜不干净，而是，你可能要当爹了。”
“什么？”蓝烨磊呆愣的捧起沈沛珊的头问道：“珊儿你说什么？”
沈沛珊笑着说：“我可能是有喜了。”
“真的吗？珊儿你说我要当爹了是吗？”蓝烨磊不确定的又问了一遍。
“你忘记我是个医生了吗？我想，我是有喜了。”沈沛珊笑着说道。“要不，你请逸闻大师来给我把下脉，不就清楚了吗？”

事实上，沈沛珊说的没错，她怀孕了。
蓝烨磊被这个事实震憾的开心不已，回到将军府，蓝烨磊小心翼翼的将沈沛珊扶下马车。好消息很快的传开，沈夫人派人到将军府，让沈沛珊回御史府住段时间。
沈夫人托人捎话说，刚刚有身孕时，吃东西会比较挑剔，有沈夫人的照顾，可以吃的可口些。
沈沛珊有些动心，想同蓝烨磊一起回御史府住几日。
蓝烨磊心中想的却是不同，他怕再次面对沈傲珊，上次的事情还让他心有余悸，他不知道如果再有类似的情况发生，他该怎样处理。
可是见沈沛珊满心热情，又不好打消她的念头。
好吧！他心想，自己的提防着些就好了。
于是两人晚饭都没有吃，就起身去了御史府。

> Chapter 27 You are happy (page 1)
"Look what we're eating today?" Lan Yelei opened the lid.
There are four plates of side dishes and a bowl of porridge, including stir-fried shrimps, mapo tofu, vegetarian stir-fried cabbage, steamed sea bass, and a bowl of lean meat porridge, which are Shen Peishan's favorites.
"Ms. sir, did you order the kitchen to cook it?" Shen Peishan asked in surprise. She picked up the chopsticks and ate happily.
"Fool, have you forgotten that you are not allowed to faint from eating in the temple?" Lan Yelei said with a smile, "I just bought it from the city on horseback."
Shen Peishan stopped the chopsticks in her hand, looked at Lan Yelei, and said movedly: "Ms. sir, you got up early in the morning and went out to buy food for me?"
"Yeah! I see that you don't like to eat very much lately, so I just want to buy something you like." Holding Shen Peishan's slender waist, Lan Yelei said, "Look at you, you have lost weight again. How can you not eat? Eat quickly, or you will get cold if you don't eat."
Shen Peishan turned around and hugged Lan Yelei, put her head against his chest, and listened to his steady heartbeat, "My husband treats me so well!"
"Fool, if I don't treat you well, who should I treat well?" He picked up the chopsticks and stuffed them into Shen Peishan's hands, "Eat quickly! If you don't eat, it will be really cold."
Shen Peishan picked up a shrimp, put it in Lan Yelei's mouth and said, "Then let's eat together."
Lan Yelei chewed the shrimp sweetly, which seemed to be more delicious than delicacies from the mountains and seas, with a smile always on his face.
Probably because the food suited her appetite, Shen Peishan ate a lot and was very full. As soon as she put down the bowl and chopsticks, a nauseating feeling surged into her throat, and she quickly ran out the door. Shen Peishan held on to the big tree in the yard and vomited violently. She gave all the food she had just eaten to the Land Master.
Lan Yelei's face turned green with fright, and he asked anxiously: "Shan'er, what's wrong with you? Is the food not cooked cleanly? Why are you vomiting so much?"
It seemed that her stomach was turned upside down before Shen Peishan stopped vomiting. Seeing that Lan Yelei was as anxious as an ant on a hot pot, she burst into laughter.
"Fool," she shyly threw herself into his arms and said softly, "It's not that the food is unclean, but that you might be a father."
"What?" Lan Yelei held up Shen Peishan's head blankly and asked, "Shan'er, what did you say?"
Shen Peishan smiled and said, "I may be happy."
"Really? Shan'er, you said I'm going to be a father, right?" Lan Yelei asked again uncertainly.
"Have you forgotten that I am a doctor? I think I am happy." Shen Peishan said with a smile. "How about you ask Master Yiwen to check my veins? Wouldn't it be clear?"
In fact, Shen Peishan was right, she was pregnant.
Lan Yelei was shocked and happy by this fact. When he returned to the general's mansion, Lan Yelei carefully helped Shen Peishan out of the carriage. The good news spread quickly, and Mrs. Shen sent someone to the General's Mansion to ask Shen Peishan to go back to the Yushi Mansion to stay for a while.
Mrs. Shen asked someone to tell her that when she was just pregnant, she would be picky about what she ate. With Mrs. Shen taking care of her, she could eat more deliciously.
Shen Peishan was a little tempted and wanted to go back to the Yushi Mansion to stay with Lan Yelei for a few days.
Lan Yelei had something different in mind. He was afraid of facing Shen Aoshan again. What happened last time still left him with lingering fears. He didn't know how he would handle it if a similar situation happened again.
But seeing that Shen Peishan was full of enthusiasm, it was difficult to give up her idea.
All right! He thought to himself that it would be better if he were more careful.
So the two of them got up and went to the Censor's Mansion without eating dinner.
